reviews.title: WAY MANY ADS
reviews.text:
Basically I installed this app on my phone because my brother wanted to get the app.
Since this app has tons of ads, my brother threw my phone over the floor
Luckily it was a carpet so there was no damage.
But, my brother doesn’t have a phone so he uses mine.
I asked him why and this was his response screaming his head: “IM NOT PAYING MONEY FOR SOME SUBSCRIPTIONS”
Followed with my mom walking in the room and saying: “I PAID £180 FOR THAT PHONE, IF YOU BREAK IT I’LL BREAK YOUR PS4”

my brother was grounded that day :D

reviews.title: TO MANY ADS!
reviews.text: I downloaded this app a few years ago and it’s great most of the Addons I downloaded worked and I had no issues . But recently I can’t even look through the selection of Addons because of how many adds pop up on my screen. Every 10 seconds u scroll you get hit with a 30 second ad that covers your whole screen . And you also have to watch even more adds just to download an Addons. Ads have made the app useless now. I wouldn’t download this app to any new users because it is utter rubbish.

reviews.title: Recent review 2026
reviews.text: This app used to be so good like #1 in my book. I mean you could download so many mods and scroll, with very minimal ads. and for like $1 or 2 a month you get no ads (which I create fully purchased). Now they’ve updated the pricing to like $8-9 / month and I get it, in this economy. the problem is they’ve made the free version of the app unusable. I watch 5 mins of an ad as soon as I open the app .. then I search for what I need and I watch another ad. and if u scroll 2 times cuz the first suggestion isn’t what ur looking for.. BOOM ANOTHER AD..just for them to not have what i’m looking for in the end. It’s really disappointing because I genuinely loved this app and would use it for my content creation. I used to swear by it but I think i’m going to have to let it go now. Sorry, it’s been real 😞

reviews.title: Adds on Adds
reviews.text:
I don’t wanna see a reply “we’re sorry adds keep the app free, but we do offer a subscription for no adds” because at that point? I would rather spend the money to buy the app then to buy monthly subscription. I get it supported but at the same time? Leaving the longest ads possible for the sake of “keeping the app free” is what makes people not wanna download the app in the first place. It has great mods don’t get me wrong, but I would rather take the risk of downloading a virus on a mod website then to deal with me scrolling two times and have an add pop up every two scrolls. It gets annoying after awhile. Great app, horrible execution of your add sponsors though. Add ons? 7/10

App in general though? 2/10 because the adds are so long and frankly give me a headache dealing with 3 minutes of watching someone promise smt about a stupid game.
